name: Haughty Obstinacy
description: Your pride shrugs off those who would rule you: +1 to Will saves.

name: Cooperative Nature
description: You have learned to get along: +2 to Diplomacy checks.

name: Road-Hardened
description: Years on Vardmoor's roads have toughened you: +1 HP per level.

name: Clever Improviser
description: You make do: +1 to checks with skills you are untrained in.

name: Stonecunning
description: You read stone and shadow: +1 to Perception.

name: Dwarven Toughness
description: Dwarven stubbornness keeps you standing: +1 HP per level.

name: Rock Runner
description: Sure-footed on any ground: +1 to Reflex saves.

name: Unburdened Iron
description: You were made for armour: body armour never slows you.

name: Nimble Elf
description: Light on your feet: +5 ft speed.

name: Elven Instincts
description: Nothing escapes your notice: +1 to Perception.

name: Elven Lore
description: You were taught the old names: +2 to Arcana and Nature checks.

name: Unwavering Mien
description: Your mind is your own: +1 to Will saves.

name: Bloody Blows
description: Your strikes leave deep wounds: +2 damage on a critical hit.

name: Orc Ferocity
description: You fight on through pain: +1 HP per level.

name: Orc Superstition
description: Old charms guard your mind: +1 to Will saves.

name: Menacing Presence
description: You know how to loom: +2 to Intimidation checks.

name: Sure Feet
description: You never lose your footing: +1 to Reflex saves and +2 to Acrobatics checks.

name: Halfling Luck
description: Luck runs in your family: +1 to Fortitude saves.

name: Keen Eyes
description: Small folk see what big folk miss: +1 to Perception.

name: Unfettered Halfling
description: Nothing holds you for long: +5 ft speed.

name: Cinder Skin
description: The god's ash lives in your skin: fire resistance 2.

name: Taint Eater
description: Your blood is used to the Taint: it builds a quarter more slowly in you.

name: Ember Sight
description: Your eyes catch a glow others can't: +1 to Perception.

name: Ash Walker
description: You move like drifting ash: +5 ft speed.

name: Intimidating Strike
description: A new ability: Strike, and on a hit the target is frightened 1 (2 on a critical hit). 10 Fury.

name: Brutish Shove
description: A new ability: Strike, and on a hit knock the target back 1.5 tiles and leave it off-guard for 2 s. 10 Fury.

name: Lunge
description: You strike from further off: +1 tile of melee reach.

name: Knockdown
description: A new ability: Strike, and on a hit knock the target prone for 1.5 s. 20 Fury, 6 s cooldown.

name: Swipe
description: A new ability: one whirling swing at every enemy within reach, all around you. 25 Fury.

name: Furious Focus
description: Battle feeds you: +4 Fury on every hit.

name: Reach Spell
description: Your spells carry further: +3 tiles of spell range.

name: Cantrip Expansion: Electric Arc
description: A new cantrip: an arc of lightning that leaps to a second enemy.

name: Cantrip Expansion: Ray of Frost
description: A new cantrip: a ray of cold that slows its target.

name: Force Volley
description: Force Bolt looses one more missile.

name: Linked Focus
description: Your Mana regenerates a quarter faster.

name: Arcane Ward
description: A standing ward: +1 to AC.

name: Toughness
description: You can take more punishment: +1 HP per level.

name: Fleet
description: You move more quickly: +5 ft speed.

name: Canny Acumen
description: Your mind is hard to sway: +2 to Will saves.

name: Incredible Recovery
description: You catch your breath quickly: out-of-combat recovery is half as fast again.

name: Sense the Dead
description: You feel the restless dead: +2 to Religion checks and +1 to Perception.

name: Hardy Recovery
description: You've marched on worse: out-of-combat recovery is a quarter faster, and +2 to Athletics checks.

name: Recall Lore
description: You remember what you read: +2 to all Lore checks.

name: Quick Lockpick
description: Locks don't slow you: +2 to Thievery checks.

name: Shrine Ward
description: The Lantern's rites steady you: +1 to Will saves and +2 to Religion checks.

name: Track Prey
description: You read signs in mud and grass: +2 to Survival checks and +1 to Perception.

name: Pickpocket
description: Light fingers: +2 to Thievery and Stealth checks.

name: Silver Tongue
description: You talk your way through: +2 to Diplomacy and Deception checks.

name: Cat Fall
description: You land well and dodge better: +1 to Reflex saves and +2 to Acrobatics checks.

name: Recognize Spell
description: You know a spell when you see one: +2 to Arcana checks and +1 to Will saves.

name: Battle Medicine
description: You patch yourself up between fights: out-of-combat recovery is half as fast again.

name: Intimidating Glare
description: A look is enough: +2 to Intimidation checks.

name: Lie to Me
description: You know a lie when you hear one: +2 to Deception checks and +1 to Perception.

name: Quick Repair
description: You can mend most things: +2 to Crafting checks.

name: Natural Medicine
description: You know the healing herbs: +2 to Nature checks, and out-of-combat recovery is a quarter faster.

name: Oddity Identification
description: You spot the uncanny: +2 to Occultism checks and +1 to Will saves.

name: Terrain Stalker
description: You move unseen: +2 to Stealth checks.

name: Streetwise
description: You know how towns work: +2 to Society and Diplomacy checks.

name: Fascinating Performance
description: You hold a crowd: +2 to Performance checks.

name: Titan Wrestler
description: You can grapple anything: +2 to Athletics checks and +1 to Fortitude saves.

name: Student of the Canon
description: You know the Lantern's texts: +2 to Religion checks.

name: Experienced Tracker
description: No trail is cold to you: +2 to Survival checks.

name: Breaker of Embers
description: You smashed Sallow's Cinder Relic. +1 to Will saves, and the Taint builds in you a quarter more slowly.

name: Ward of the Lantern
description: Brother Anselm's blessing. Resistance 2 to void, and the Taint builds in you a quarter more slowly.

name: The Scarecrow's Peace
description: The spirit you freed keeps watch with you. +1 to Perception, and you move 5 feet faster.

name: Vanguard
description: Two-handed weapons, cleaves and knockback. Earthshaker: with a two-handed weapon, slam the ground and every enemy within 2 tiles takes your weapon's damage (a basic Reflex save against your class DC), knocked back 1.5 tiles on a failure. Your Cleave reaches one more enemy and costs 5 less Fury.

name: Bulwark
description: Sword and shield, blocks, counters and taunts. Challenge: roar at every enemy within 5 tiles; they turn on you, and those that fail a Will save against your class DC are frightened 1 (2 on a critical failure). Shield Block takes 2 more off a blow, and after it you strike back at the attacker.

name: Pyromancer
description: Fire, burning and areas. Burning Hands: a 3-tile cone of flame, 2d6 fire (+1d6 a rank above 1) against a basic Reflex save. Ignition splashes 1 fire on the enemies round its target (2 from rank 3).

name: Stormcaller
description: Lightning chains, cold and control. Thunderclap: lightning cracks round you, 2d4 electricity (+1d4 a rank above 1) to every enemy within 2.5 tiles against a basic Reflex save, knocked back a tile on a failure. Electric Arc leaps to one more enemy and Ray of Frost slows for a second longer, once you have them.

name: Battering Blows
description: Vanguard: Power Attack knocks its target back 1.5 tiles.

name: Steadfast Guard
description: Bulwark: Raise a Shield lasts 3 s longer (9 s).

name: Widen Spell
description: Pyromancer: Burning Hands reaches a tile further (4 tiles).

name: Rolling Thunder
description: Stormcaller: Thunderclap reaches a tile further and knocks back a tile more.

name: Cutthroat
description: Sneak attacks, wounds and stealth. Gutting Strike: a Strike that opens a deep wound, 1d6 persistent bleed on a hit. A Strike out of hiding that hits is a critical hit, and you move at full speed while hidden.

name: Trickster
description: Traps, feints and misdirection. Snare: a trap at your feet that springs on the first enemy to step close, piercing every enemy round it (a basic Reflex save) and holding them fast on a failure. Every enemy within a tile of your Tumble is left off-guard for 3 s.

name: Twin Feint
description: A new ability: two quick Strikes, the second a feint the target is off-guard against. 15 Momentum.

name: Nimble Dodge
description: You're hard to pin down: +1 to AC.

name: Deep Cuts
description: Cutthroat: Gutting Strike's wound bleeds a die more (2d6).

name: Wide Snare
description: Trickster: Snare catches enemies half a tile further and holds them a second longer.

name: Whirling Blades
description: A new ability: one Strike at every enemy within reach, all round you. 25 Momentum.

name: Relentless
description: Every blow drives you on: +4 Momentum on every hit.

name: Opportunist
description: You know where it hurts: your sneak attack deals one more d6.

name: Marksman
description: Bows, piercing shots and chains of critical hits. Piercing Shot: an arrow with one more weapon die that flies on through up to 3 enemies behind its target. Every arrow you loose passes through one enemy behind its target, and a critical hit with a bow gives back 5 Focus.

name: Beastmaster
description: An animal companion and its own feats. A wolf fights at your side: it follows you, falls on what you attack and on whatever attacks you, grows with your level, and if it falls it comes back to you after 20 s. Sic 'Em: send it at a monster to bite and knock it prone.

name: Far Shot
description: Your arrows carry further: +2 tiles of bow range.

name: Swift Tracker
description: You move quickly on the trail: +5 ft speed.

name: Deadly Aim
description: Marksman: +4 damage on a critical hit, and Aimed Shot costs 5 less Focus.

name: Pack Hunter
description: Beastmaster: your wolf grows: half as many hit points again, and its bite deals one more die.

name: Relentless Hunt
description: Your prey has nowhere to hide: Hunt Prey deals one more d8.

name: Focused Mind
description: Your Focus returns a quarter faster.

name: Hunter's Eye
description: Nothing escapes your notice: +2 to Perception and +1 tile of bow range.

name: Lanternbearer
description: Light, healing and the bane of the dead. Lantern's Radiance: an aura of holy light that burns the enemies round you (vitality against the undead, fire against the living) and heals you and your allies. Your Strikes against the undead deal 1 more vitality damage (2 at level 9), Lay on Hands heals half as much again, and your lantern lights 1.5 tiles further.

name: Oathbreaker
description: The Taint as a weapon: life drain and fear. Aura of Dread: an aura that frightens and drains the enemies round you, paid for out of your Taint meter. Each of your hits fills your Taint meter by 3, and your Strikes deal 1 Taint damage for every 25 in the meter, healing you as much. Mind the whispers at 100.

name: Fervor
description: Every hit you land builds 4 more Devotion.

name: Resolute Faith
description: Your faith steadies you: +1 to Fortitude, Reflex and Will saves.

name: Beacon
description: Lanternbearer: Lantern's Radiance reaches a tile further and costs 5 less Devotion.

name: Spreading Dread
description: Oathbreaker: Aura of Dread reaches a tile further and costs 5 less Taint.

name: Healing Hands
description: Lay on Hands costs 5 less Devotion.

name: Iron Devotion
description: Clad in your oath: +1 AC.

name: Righteous Wrath
description: Your critical hits deal 4 more damage.

name: Bonelord
description: A skeleton army and armour of bone. Bone Armor: bones knit round you for 15 s, a ward that takes 4 off a blow. You hold one more skeleton.

name: Plaguebringer
description: Curses, rot and corpse explosions. Corpse Explosion: the grave's rot bursts round a monster, void against a basic Fortitude save, sickening those who fail. Each corpse gives you one more Grave Charge, and Grave Bolt splashes 1 void on the enemies round its target (2 from rank 3).

name: Grave Reach
description: Your spells reach 2 tiles further.

name: Soul Siphon
description: Your Mana returns a quarter faster.

name: Legion
description: Bonelord: your skeletons are sturdier: half as many hit points again, +1 AC and attack, and a die more.

name: Virulent Blast
description: Plaguebringer: Corpse Explosion reaches a tile further.

name: Grave Hoarder
description: You hold 2 more Grave Charges.

name: Hardened Bones
description: Your skeletons are sturdier: half as many hit points again, +1 AC and attack, and a die more.

name: Deathless Will
description: The grave's whispers have hardened you: +2 to Will saves.

name: Fighter Dedication
description: You trained in arms: Power Attack, a ponderous blow with an extra weapon die. It spends Fury, which you now build as a fighter does: from the blows you land and take.

name: Wizard Dedication
description: You learned a little magic: Force Bolt, two bolts of force that never miss. It spends Mana, from a small pool of your own (half a wizard's, from your Intelligence).

name: Rogue Dedication
description: You learned to move like a thief: Tumble, a roll up to 3.5 tiles toward the pointer, through enemies and untouched.

name: Ranger Dedication
description: You learned to hunt: Hunt Prey marks a monster, and your Strikes against it deal 1d8 more precision damage.

name: Champion Dedication
description: You swore an oath: Lay on Hands, healing 6 HP a spell rank. It spends Devotion, which you build from the blows you take.

name: Necromancer Dedication
description: You learned the grave's art: Raise Bones calls a skeleton to fight for you (one at a time), paid with a Grave Charge from the dead around you or from a small pool of Mana.
